author: Sandra Yonker
text: We had water heater And pressure tank go out. We started calling plumbers when we had no water. He called us back in an hour. Sent him pictures and after quote, was there by next morning before 8 am. Was done in 3 hours. He called back within minutes when we had some questions. Highly recommend Jake and his helper Hayden. Both were  friendly and helpful . And they took the old water heater and pressure tank so to me that is a plus.

author: Nicole Stapleton
text: Our sump pump failed on Friday and we called Jake and he got us in and had us up and running by evening! We highly recommend him as he has great customer service! We now have a fancy new sump with a battery back up!

author: Gary Smith
text: He was professional, knowledgeable and efficient. Repair was done perfectly. Definitely recommend him if you’re looking for quality work at a reasonable price.

author: Christina Petersen
text: Highly recommend Jake!! He responded quickly and even got a new hot water heater installed the same day. Very nice, knowledgeable and upfront. Can't recommend him enough!

author: Sophie Tokarski
text: I cannot recommend Jake’s Plumbing LLC enough! had a plumbing leak over the holiday weekend. Jake answered my call promptly and fit me into his schedule very quickly, communicating with me every step of the way. He is very knowledgeable and took the time to explain what he found in my house and exactly what he was going to do to fix it. He’s very personable and works quickly and efficiently. Don’t waste another day calling around just to be put on a lengthy cancellation list by the other companies. Call Jake first!
